methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

actual_scope: Complete exact census of unordered two-role whole-helper swaps between distinct owner bins on the selected PR1094 owner map, retaining all call times, helper widths and source-event windows; classify the idle-moment change for every real 0<a<1.
scope_change_reason: The live packing searches and broad ceilings overlap newer PRs. The nearest complete census (research/frontier1094-single-relocation) covers one-role relocations and explicitly lists swaps among its non-exclusions; the complex-t16-* whole-helper exchanges are heuristic search bests on ancestor maps. An exact two-role swap census on the selected map is a distinct bounded residual subproblem using the exponent-uniform concavity decision instead of a floating-point score.
bottleneck_link: Only a changed idle-rank histogram can improve the fully priced complex moment on this unchanged word. A complete no-improvement census of the second move class identifies another exhausted local move class without excluding multi-role repacking, neutral paths or changed words.
stop_rule: Exhaust the unordered two-role swap domain once; stop whether a legal improvement or an exact local obstruction is found. Reserve the final quarter of the session for independent controls and handoff.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: 2388752640 unordered role pairs over 69120 roles partition exactly into 88345 same-bin no-ops, 1570734429 capacity-infeasible pairs, 816035605 neutral, 1893111 strictly worsening and 1150 strictly improving pairs; all 1150 improving pairs fail the strict source-event window on at least one landing, so no legal strictly improving swap exists even with the active-pair and family rules relaxed. Thirteen test groups include an exact radical oracle at a=1/2 (4032 quadruples), a toy brute-force census cross-check, pair-aware family controls and certificate/source tamper controls. Packing cap from ceiling(local, 73, 896, 9, 64): a < 0.001690054109089 (kappa cap 0.001687202645325402); fraction realized 0.0.

open_questions.question: Can a legal capacity-neutral swap followed by one improving swap escape this exact two-move fixed point?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The census counts 816035605 capacity-neutral pairs; a legal neutral swap can change which windows bind and unlock a later improving swap. This is a changed two-step domain, not excluded here.
open_questions.first_step: Filter the neutral pairs by the same landing rules, apply each legal one, and enumerate the newly possible improving pairs on the changed map, with a canonical ordered pair of swaps.
open_questions.blocked_by: The legal-neutral set must be enumerated with the pair-aware family rule before second moves can be counted; no two-step coverage or admission is performed in this package.

open_questions.question: Do three-role cyclic transfers among three owner bins admit a legal strictly improving move when every two-role swap is blocked?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A 3-cycle preserves total rank and can spread remainders where all 2-swaps fail; it is the next named move class after swaps.
open_questions.first_step: Derive the majorization sign rule for cyclic transfers (x1,x2,x3) -> (x1+d1,x2+d2,x3+d3) with sum d_i = 0 and count capacity-feasible improving triples by role class.
open_questions.blocked_by: Triple materialization is roughly three orders of magnitude larger than this census and needs a window/family join designed first.

method: Enumerate every unordered pair of hosted roles through an exact role-class table (own-bin remainder, width); use the concavity majorization rule (new maximum remainder versus old) to decide the moment sign for all 0<a<1, then check every improving pair against the strict source-event windows, the active-pair restriction and the pair-aware per-call family uniqueness.

domain.repack: compact both slices' occupied prefixes without changing any other role's bin identity

optimistic_budget: Local recursive calls, bit supplier and extra charges are fixed; a swap changes only the two affected bins' idle ranks. Any gain is bounded by the packing ceiling cap kappa < 0.001687202645325402 (+0.87% over the selected kappa); no candidate is a new supplier without full admission.
